evidence_summary: Sagane et al. 2008 detected mouse LGI4-HA association with ADAM23; ADAM22 was stronger and ADAM11/ADAM23 showed moderate LGI4 binding in the family comparison.
limitations: Direct/complex-proximal cell-surface association is supported, but the assay is heterologous/cell-based and does not provide purified binary affinity, stoichiometry, or complete receptor-complex composition. ADAM22 is the stronger LGI4 partner in this experiment; no relay or function is inferred from binding alone. High is limited to the tested cell-surface association; no downstream relay or SCI inference is made.
